questions.q: Why is a CSI camera better than USB for a control loop?
questions.explain: 1–2 frames of latency and direct access to the ISP; USB adds buffers and a controller.

questions.q: What is a rolling shutter and why is it bad for navigation?

questions.explain: A long queue = growing latency when the algorithm is slow.

questions.q: How do you measure glass-to-glass latency?
options: From the stream's FPS and resolution
A timer and the window in one photo
questions.explain: The most honest method for the whole chain.

questions.q: The main contributor to RTSP stream latency to the GCS is usually:
questions.explain: Reduce latency in the receiver, more frequent iframes.

questions.q: What should you do if auto exposure “flickers” when the vehicle tilts?
questions.explain: AE reacts to the sky/ground in the frame.

questions.q: Why is YUV420 convenient for algorithms?
options: It's uncompressed: the frame doesn't need decoding
It only works with USB cameras in MJPEG mode
questions.explain: YUV420 needs no decoding, unlike MJPEG and H.264.

questions.q: Where is the latency of an IP camera or HDMI capture acceptable?
options: Video for the operator, not a control loop
questions.explain: 100+ ms is acceptable for viewing, bad for a closed loop.
